issue.body:
## Summary

The Active filter is showing completed tasks instead of tasks that are
still pending.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Launch the application.
2. Open the All filter.
3. Confirm that both completed and incomplete tasks are visible.
4. Select the Active filter.

## Expected behavior

Only incomplete tasks should be displayed.

## Actual behavior

The Active filter displays completed tasks.

The result is effectively the same as the Completed filter.

## Additional context

- The All filter works correctly.
- The Completed filter works correctly.
- Toggling a task does not fix the issue.
- The behavior appears to be specific to the Active filter logic.
issue.title: Active filter shows completed tasks instead of pending tasks
